newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania c.bank refinancing loans down in July.
newsitem.headline: Romania c.bank refinancing loans down in July.

text.p: Romania's refinancing credits eased by 5.9 percent last month after a 8.8 percent fall in June, continuing the downswing started in January after the central bank (BNR) tightened monetary policy, BNR data showed.
The total daily refinancing was 3.71 trillion lei on average in July, when structural credits dropped to 1.77 trillion lei from two trillion the previous month.
Credits granted to debtors in dispute at law, respectively to troubled banks Dacia Felix SA and Renasterea Creditului Romanesc Credit Bank SA, stayed frozen at 1.88 trillion lei.
Both banks, which revealed big debts and losses, await court rulings on their reorganisation or liquidation.
The bulk of structural loans bear an annual 50 percent interest, while the BNR does not charge interest on credits granted to Dacia Felix and Credit Bank.
The daily average of Lombard loans was 2.5 billion lei in July against almost zero the previous month. The BNR gave no auction or special refinancing facilities last month. ($=7,434 lei)
